nodes.label: App Favicon Logo
nodes.description: 32x32 SVG app icon: rounded teal square (#0e6b5e, rx=7) with a cream (#f7f3ea) U-shaped quadratic curve (parabola-like) and a small cream dot beneath its vertex; reads as a minimalist math/graph mark for the app.

nodes.label: Brand Palette (teal #0e6b5e, cream #f7f3ea)
nodes.rationale: Two-color palette of deep teal and warm cream gives a calm, academic look and high contrast at favicon size.

nodes.label: App Icon 192px (PWA)
nodes.rationale: 192x192 PWA/home-screen icon: a dark teal-green plus/cross shape on a white background, with a cream-white U-shaped curve (resembling a parabola y=x^2 or a necklace/smile) drawn across it. Likely blends a math motif (parabola, fitting a 'toan' = math app) with a cross/plus symbol; the green cross could alternatively evoke a pharmacy/health brand. Flat, minimal design suited to small launcher sizes.

nodes.label: App Icon (512px)
nodes.rationale: 512x512 PWA/app icon: a deep teal-green plus sign (addition symbol) on a transparent background, overlaid with a cream parabola (U-shaped curve) whose vertex is marked by a dot. It combines arithmetic (plus) and algebra/graphing (parabola with vertex) to signal a math learning app ('ban toan'); flat two-color design keeps it legible at small sizes. The 512px size matches the standard PWA manifest/splash icon requirement.

nodes.label: markPaid (SELECT FOR UPDATE, payment_events)
nodes.rationale: Row lock plus ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so concurrent webhooks issue one code and one commission.

nodes.label: server/http/bridge.ts HTTP bridge
nodes.rationale: Vercel functions and the Vite dev/preview plugin both go through the bridge so env loading, 413 limits, opaque 500s and x-request-id behave identically everywhere.
